title: Decimal to Fraction Converter
description: Turn any decimal into its simplest fraction with the GCD steps shown, plus an optional denominator cap.
howto: Optionally set a max denominator for the closest simple fraction.
Press Convert to see the fraction and the working.

faqs.a: 0.75 has 2 decimal places, so it becomes 75/100, and dividing by GCD 25 gives 3/4.
It finds the closest fraction with a denominator at or below your cap using continued fractions — handy for measurements like 0.333 → 1/3.
Enter as many repeating digits as you like (e.g. 0.3333); with a denominator cap it will converge to the neat fraction.
